'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet, mostly typed, name MHT, event Worlds Day 3, deck name Communing LL. Ditto marks expanded. Line 44 is Padme Naberrie (It Could Be Worse crossed out).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
